name: @forgemeshlabs/x402-scan-mcp
description: Free x402 Endpoint Scanner MCP server. Probes paid endpoints for a well-formed HTTP 402 challenge, validates the PAYMENT-REQUIRED envelope, detects MPP dual-stack discovery, and grades A-F.

tools.name: scan_endpoint
tools.description: Scan one x402 endpoint for a valid 402 challenge, MPP dual-stack support, and an A-F health grade.

tools.name: scan_batch
tools.description: Run scan_endpoint over up to 10 URLs and return each result plus a one-line summary.

tools.name: census_stats
tools.description: Fetch live ForgeMesh catalog stats plus the static August 2026 x402 Bazaar health census headline numbers.
